issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台默认 150f，比镜头本意多出 20f 尾巴
铺垫段的节拍点是一颗灰色实心圆，直接压在最后一行列表的内容上，像渲染残留
爆入后的舞台是 #2f2f2f 平涂灰，"DROP" 是 Helvetica 平涂白字，没有光、没有层次
冲击环是 10px 白色实线圈，边缘生硬，像矢量描边而不是能量波
5f 撞入只有 scale 变化，没有曝光冲击与拖影，爆点不够响；落定后画面只剩一个词，缺少收束信息
changes: 补 DROP_BLACKOUT_SLAM_DURATION = 130；切黑 50、爆入 62、12f 纯黑 #0c0c0c、1.35→1 / 10px 震屏 / 80→900px 环 16f 等节拍参数不变
节拍点改为顶栏空位里的 "Live session · 150 BPM" 胶囊：四根电平条每 12f 被敲一拍、逐条错 0.8f 指数衰减，录制红点同拍呼吸，不再压内容
舞台换成带色相的深色径向渐变 + 标题背后靛蓝余光（爆开满、18f 落到 0.55）+ 暗角 0.5 + 10% 颗粒；DROP 改系统字体 800、白→淡靛纵向渐变字面 + 柔辉光
爆入帧加中心泛白曝光冲击（0.55→0，6f）与两层向外放大的缩放拖影（4f 消失）；冲击环改为 6→1.5px 细亮芯 + 内外柔光晕
标题落定后 t=8–20 眉题 "The new release · Out now"（34px）从下方 16px ease-out 浮上，之后 48f 真静止
issuesEn: No exported duration; the workbench defaulted to 150f, 20f longer than the shot intends
The pre-drop beat marker was a solid grey dot sitting on top of the last list row, like a render artefact
After the drop the stage was flat #2f2f2f grey and 'DROP' was flat white Helvetica, with no light or depth
The shock ring was a 10px solid white circle with hard edges, reading as a vector stroke rather than an energy wave
The 5f slam was scale only, with no exposure hit or trail, so the drop lacked punch; the settled frame had a single word and nothing to close on
changesEn: Added DROP_BLACKOUT_SLAM_DURATION = 130; blackout at 50, slam at 62, 12f of #0c0c0c, 1.35→1 scale, 10px shake and 80→900px ring over 16f all unchanged

The beat marker is now a 'Live session · 150 BPM' pill in empty top-bar space: four level bars hit every 12f, each decaying exponentially 0.8f after the last, with a recording dot pulsing on the beat; nothing covers content

Stage is now a tinted dark radial gradient with an indigo halo behind the word (full at impact, easing to 0.55 over 18f), a 0.5 vignette and 10% grain; DROP uses the system font at 800 with a white-to-pale-indigo fill and a soft glow
The impact frame adds a centre exposure bloom (0.55→0 over 6f) and two outward zoom trails that fade within 4f; the ring is now a bright 6→1.5px core with soft inner and outer glow
After the word lands, a 34px eyebrow 'The new release · Out now' rises 16px on ease-out at t=8–20, followed by a 48f true hold
